description: M3-08 approved exceptions: frozen M1 cases whose production behaviour differs by an owner-approved decision. Each entry names the exact case and the exact difference; `actual` is the exact production output recorded for a driven case, or null when the adapter cannot yet drive the case (the gate then reports it as an approved exception that is not driven and fails). Frozen fixtures and their expectations are never changed; fixture_sha256 pins them. See docs/implementation/M3-08-CLOSURE-MAP.md.

exceptions.difference: After crash_after_dispatch the controlled adapter holds durable evidence that the bound effect was applied, so reconcile records observed_success (count 1, as expected) instead of unknown_reconcile; the retry then replays {replayed: true, result: effect_completed} instead of RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED. Final: receipts {observed_success: 1} instead of {unknown_reconcile: 1}, refusals 0 instead of 1; consumed_permits 1, effects_applied 1 and grant_uses {} unchanged.

Step 1 reconcile {idempotency_key: k1, observed: applied} is a client assertion; production provides no client-asserted reconciliation (outcomes come only from adapter evidence, D-035 item 3), so the expected {outcome: applied, result: reconciled} and the replayed effect_completed have no production counterpart.

Step 1 reconcile {idempotency_key: k1, observed: not_applied} would release an uncertain key for redispatch on a client assertion; production never does (D-036 item 3, D-035 item 3), so the expected {outcome: not_applied, result: reconciled} and the fresh effect_completed have no production counterpart.
Expected PERMIT_MISSING comes from the client-held promotion permit being null; production has no client-held promotion permit (use-time decision on the sealed request inside Broker::promote).
Step 0 expects PERMIT_MISSING from a null client permit; production has no client-held promotion permit.
Expected PERMIT_REQUEST_MISMATCH comes from the client permit's request_fingerprint differing from the request; production has no client-held promotion permit.
